quote: Retire or supersede the claim when accepting a canonical event row with `updatedAt >=` the claim timestamp, and add a deferred-refresh regression.
note: The earlier “Retire claims on accepted newer session events” finding warned that an accepted event could leave a stale claim in place. That points to the same claim retirement logic, but the finding did not identify the shipped failure, where a title event cleared the claim even though reconciliation kept the old row.
